title: Agent Reach launches open source CLI to access multiple #agentreach #aiscraping #aidevelopment
description: Agent Reach released a free open source CLI tool that enables AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to scrape data from platforms including Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, XiaoHongShu, and Bilibili. It provides seamless access to over a dozen platforms with a single terminal command, simplifying data extraction across multiple sources. The tool automates platform-specific scraping workflows, requiring minimal setup—only platforms like Twitter and Reddit need a quick login via exported browser cookies. Others like YouTube and GitHub work without additional configuration, thanks to built-in routing of requests. Agent Reach also features a diagnostic command that verifies platform readiness, reducing time spent on debugging and authentication. By consolidating disparate scraping methods into one accessible interface, Agent Reach accelerates data gathering for AI applications, research, and analysis, saving users hours or even days of manual setup and troubleshooting. #AgentReach #ClaudeCode #CursorAI #WebScraping #OpenSourceTools #YouTubeScraping #RedditScraping #TwitterScraping #GitHubScraping #XiaoHongShu #Bilibili #AIAgents #DataExtraction #CLItools #Automation
